C0968.title: Reselling Order-Grabbing Software to Didi Drivers Case
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0968.summary: Starting in January 2024, Liu and two others bought plug-in order-grabbing programs such as Shan Dian Xia and Bao Li Tu online and resold them to Didi drivers for automated order grabbing, charging by commission or by day. About eight months later, the people involved were arrested, and the court later found the conduct constituted illegally obtaining computer information system data. The case involved illegal proceeds of more than 156,000 yuan, and the court imposed a three-year prison sentence with suspension and a fine.

references.title: Three People Convicted for Selling Didi Ride-Hailing Order-Grabbing Tools
